input.description: Split long text into pieces for RAG retrieval. Strategies: 'sentence' packs whole sentences into a size budget and never splits mid-sentence; 'paragraph' prefers \n\n boundaries; 'fixed' is a hard char window with overlap. The highest-value endpoint for agents that build retrieval pipelines.
